description: This source file implements Unix stream server functionalities for handling Unix domain socket connections, including creating, checking server status, and cleanup operations in a multi-process environment.

methods.name: int is_another_server_alive(const char * path,const struct unix_stream_listen_opts * opts)
methods.description: Checks if another server is listening at the specified Unix domain socket path by attempting to connect.

methods.description: Creates and binds a new Unix stream server socket at the specified path, ensuring no other server is listening.

methods.name: void unix_ss_free(struct unix_ss_socket * server_socket)
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the server socket, closing socket and cleaning up.

methods.name: int unix_ss_was_stolen(struct unix_ss_socket * server_socket)
methods.description: Determines if the server socket's underlying socket file has been replaced or stolen by another process.
